name: GLM Coding Plan Pro

price.note: Third-party price. Quarterly billing is 20% off and yearly 30% off. Confirm at z.ai/subscribe.

reset.rule: Credits come back 5 hours after you spend them.
stipulations: Credits per request are (input tokens x input rate + cached tokens x cached rate + output tokens x output rate) / 10,000.
Rates (input / cached / output): GLM-5.4 4.6 / 1.1 / 16, GLM-5.3 6.9 / 1.7 / 24, GLM-5.3-Flash 1.15 / 0.28 / 4 until 24 Dec, then 2.3 / 0.56 / 8.
Off-peak use costs half. Peak is Monday to Friday 14:00 to 18:00 Singapore time (06:00 to 10:00 UTC). Weekends are off-peak.
MCP tools (web search, web reader, Zread) cost 1.2 credits a call. Vision uses the GLM-5.3-Flash rate. There is no separate quota for any of them.

reset.rule: Resets every 7 days, counted from your subscription date.
stipulations: A request needs room in both the 5-hour and the weekly allowance.

resets.label: Quota Reset Card

count.rule: Given out now and then in Z.ai campaigns. There are two kinds: a 5-hour card and a weekly card.

resets.howTo: Look for it on the Plan Overview page. Z.ai doesn't document the steps.
stipulations: A weekly card restores the weekly quota and the 5-hour quota.
Using a card restarts that window's cycle from the moment you use it.
Each card has its own expiry date.

overage: At a limit, calls stop until that window refreshes. The plan never charges your account balance, and there's no paid overage.

how: 12,000 credits per 5 hours and 60,000 per week, spent per token on GLM models.
Off-peak hours and weekends cost half.
ext: GLM models only: GLM-5.4, GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash.
Works in Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline and other tools on Z.ai's supported list. Using it in unsupported tools or as a general API can get you rate-limited, frozen or banned.
Claude Code and Goose use https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic. Other tools use https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4.
quirks: Non-refundable. Z.ai's FAQ says cancel at least 24 hours before renewal, but its usage policy says 3 days. Allow 3 days.
The plan moved from prompt counts to credits on 30 July 2026. Legacy plans keep their terms until their billing cycle ends.
One user per subscription; no account sharing.
Price is from third-party sites because Z.ai's subscribe page didn't load.
In Claude Code, Z.ai's documented settings send every model slot to GLM-5.3-Flash. Set glm-5.4[1m] yourself to use GLM-5.4, then open a new terminal.
GLM-5.4 shows a 1M context and adds vision (third-party report, unconfirmed).
